camera: Three-quarter top-down view (SNES-era Zelda: A Link to the Past style) — subject viewed from a raised angle, facing forward/downward toward the viewer, centered and filling most of the frame.
style: AUTHENTIC LOW-RESOLUTION SPRITE, not a painted illustration and not a graph-paper mockup. Render exactly as if it were a real 32x32-tile SNES game sprite (Link to the Past / Pokemon Gen 3 overworld scale) saved and then scaled up with nearest-neighbor (blocky, NOT smoothed): each pixel is one big flat square of solid color, filling large chunky rectangular blocks. CRITICAL — DO NOT draw any visible grid lines, graph-paper lines, ruled lines, or a checkerboard/lattice pattern anywhere in the image, including the empty background — adjacent same-color pixels must merge into one solid flat rectangle with NO line or seam drawn between them; the only lines allowed are the bold ~1-pixel-thick BLACK outline around the character's silhouette and its major internal shape breaks (jacket vs fur vs boots), nothing else. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: smooth gradients, soft airbrushed shading, blur, anti-aliasing, dithering, noise, painterly brushwork, photographic texture, soft drop shadows, any grid/graph overlay. Shading is done ONLY by stepping between 2-3 flat color bands per surface (light band / base band / dark band), each a hard-edged rectangle, never a blend. Very limited palette: no more than ~16 flat colors total. Strong, simple, iconic silhouette that reads instantly at thumbnail size.
palette: Punk-rock accents — black leather, studded silver, and a loud mohawk/highlight color (hot pink, acid green, or electric blue) — set against warm overworld earth tones (mossy greens, browns, weathered wood and stone). Exact colors vary per asset, specified in the asset description.
background: 100% fully transparent background (alpha = 0), completely empty outside the character's silhouette — no scene, no shadow, no grid lines, no noise, no faint color cast, no other objects. Only the character's own opaque pixels should have any alpha at all.
constraints: Square 1:1 composition. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no drop shadow outside the subject, no gradients anywhere, no grid or graph-paper lines anywhere in the image.
